question: Should OpenClaw make best-effort secret redaction the default contract for agent-visible exec, process, node-host, and active-process results, even when this changes byte-exact diagnostic output?
rationale: The code review can establish implementation correctness, but it cannot choose the permanent security-versus-exact-output product contract on behalf of runtime owners.

options.title: Accept redacted-by-default results
options.body: Merge the security-first boundary and treat any authorized raw reveal mechanism as separate follow-up work.

options.title: Require raw reveal design first
options.body: Pause merge until maintainers define and approve an explicit authorization, audit, and UX contract for obtaining exact unredacted output.

recommendation.title: Accept redacted-by-default results
recommendation.body: Merge the security-first boundary and treat any authorized raw reveal mechanism as separate follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most strongly connects this person to the central exec/process runtime surfaces where the compatibility contract lives.
